description: Displays SVG icons from inline markup, a URL or an icon library, with sizing, color, transforms and fallbacks.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: CSS color applied to the SVG and its colorizable fills and strokes, for example red, #2563eb or var(--brand-color). Empty inherits the surrounding text color; explicit fixed SVG colors are preserved.

attributes.name: fallback
attributes.description: Plain text displayed only when no SVG can be resolved, including fallback-icon. For example, use ? for an unavailable icon. Empty leaves the reserved icon area blank.

attributes.name: fallback-icon
attributes.description: Backup icon identifier used when inline SVG, src and name provide no icon. Looked up in the selected library, then in tp; if unavailable, fallback text is used.

attributes.name: flip-h
attributes.description: Mirrors the icon horizontally when present. Remove the attribute to restore its orientation; writing false still enables it.

attributes.name: flip-v
attributes.description: Mirrors the icon vertically when present. Can be combined with flip-h and rotate; writing false still enables it.

attributes.name: library
attributes.description: Registry containing name and the first fallback-icon lookup. Built-in libraries: tp, languages, flags, numbers, letters and components. Custom registered libraries are also accepted.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Icon identifier in the selected library, for example heart or settings. Used when no inline SVG or successfully loaded src is available.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Rotation angle: a number is interpreted in degrees; deg, rad and turn units are also accepted. Negative values rotate in the opposite direction. Invalid values use 0deg; spin overrides this fixed rotation.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: Positive numeric multiplier for size, for example 0.5 to halve it or 2 to double it. Zero, negative and invalid values use 1. Changes the space occupied by the icon.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Base width and height as a CSS length, for example 24px, 2rem or 1.5em. The scale factor multiplies both dimensions; 1em follows the surrounding font size.

attributes.name: spin
attributes.description: Continuously rotates the SVG once per second when present, overriding rotate. Respects the reduced-motion preference. Remove the attribute to stop; writing false still enables it.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of an SVG file to load. Relative URLs resolve against the containing source document when available, otherwise the page URL. Inline SVG takes precedence; a failed load falls back to name, then the fallback settings.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-size
cssproperties.description: Width and height of the rendered icon; assigned internally from size multiplied by scale.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.
